core_obligations: Factor X -> Y as X -> X x_B Y -> Y using the graph and separatedness of Y -> B (proof lines 8192-8196).
Show that both factors are universally closed, the first because it is a closed immersion and the second because it is a base change of X -> B (proof lines 8196-8200).
Conclude that X -> Y is universally closed, hence that the image of |X| in |Y| is closed (proof lines 8201-8203).
Derive part (2) by combining part (1) with separatedness, quasi-compactness and finite type permanence (proof lines 8204-8207).
difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma with two assertions: in a commutative triangle X -> Y -> B over S, if X -> B is universally closed and Y -> B is separated then X -> Y is universally closed (in particular the image of |X| in |Y| is closed), and if moreover X -> B is proper then X -> Y is proper (source lines 8170-8189). The proof of (1) factors X -> Y through the graph X -> X x_B Y, which is a closed immersion by the semi-diagonal lemma and hence universally closed, and the projection X x_B Y -> Y, which is a base change of the universally closed morphism X -> B; a composite of universally closed morphisms is universally closed. Part (2) combines (1) with separatedness, quasi-compactness and finite type permanence.
